answer: Commit-reveal bond: each identity locks 70 credits and sets an anchor commitment in the registry. At dawn the reveal window opens: the agent publishes the preimage, auditors replay the registry, and a missing or reused reveal burns the bond. First filing 38, kth 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fake identities pay 3,035,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented commitments fail on the mesa registry: one per key. Honest agents file once for 38 and keep the bond.
